fixtures.transcript: Hello, thank you for having me. Over the past five years, I have focused on productionizing multimodal systems combining speech-to-text with Whisper and embedding-based retrieval. In my recent role, I scaled our inference services to handle millions of queries daily while prioritizing fairness and low latency. I'm excited about this opportunity to drive your multimodal intelligence platform forward.

Hi team! I specialize in full-stack web and platform engineering with React, TypeScript, and FastAPI backends. I really enjoy bridging intuitive UI/UX with high-throughput backend APIs, especially when processing complex AI results and keeping application state snappy and clean.
